body:
## Data-to-KPI acceleration

- Reduced data-to-KPI latency from roughly 48 hours to roughly 2 hours.
- This is a 46-hour reduction and approximately a 96% reduction in elapsed time, but use the clearer `48 hours to 2 hours` formulation in resumes.
- Operational and analytical users received current KPI information much sooner.

Do not invent dashboard counts, stakeholder counts, business units, or decisions affected.
